owner_calls.question: Keep this tie? The stage itself says Coulson and Blonsky never meet; Coulson only arranges to sabotage the Council request so Blonsky stays in his cage. Does that count as involvement with huge consequences for Blonsky, or is it knowing about him?
options: drop (they never deal with each other)
owner_calls.evidence: In The Consultant, Coulson and Sitwell talk about the Council wanting the Abomination released, then send Tony Stark to annoy Ross so the request fails. Blonsky never appears on screen with Coulson, and no other title puts them together.

owner_calls.question: The stage text never mentions Rintrah. It only says the zombie Thor kills Sara and the London Master. Should the text say how Thor and Rintrah deal with each other (Rintrah is with the two sorcerers Thor kills, and the horde kills him in the same fight)? I am keeping the tie either way.
options: keep and rewrite the text to involve Rintrah
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia on Marvel Zombies episode 4: a zombified Thor arrives and kills Blade, Sara and the London Master, and the hordes also kill Rintrah. Wikipedia does not say where the fight happens (the stage text says Paris). In episode 3 the Kamar-Taj sorcerers, Rintrah among them, rescue Parker and Lang from the Wakanda fight where Thor is gravely injured.
